evidence.description: The evidence contract's machine twin (tools/quote_check.py owns the semantics and is its one executable implementation). A claim's `evidence` is a list of items, each exactly one of two kinds, one item per source: never several sources joined in one string, never a re-rendered structure, never a `memory:` prefix. Every key here is a standard JSON Schema keyword, so the CLI's strict validator accepts it.

oneOf.description: A quote from a local file, or an owner quote when `file` is the session transcript `.jsonl` (the words are in one owner-typed record). Holds when the quote, whitespace runs collapsed, is in the file; a line range is never checked.

file.description: path relative to the checkout root or absolute, optionally with :N or :N-M

quote.description: the file's raw bytes, copied verbatim; one source per item

oneOf.description: The stdout of a read-only git command on quote_check.py's allow-list, run without a shell from the checkout root. Holds when the stdout holds the output; an empty output holds only when stdout is empty and every pathspec the command names is tracked.

command.description: one git command, no pipe, redirect or substitution

output.description: a verbatim run of the command's stdout, or the empty string for an absent claim

obsidianOpened.description: true ONLY if you consulted Worklog.md itself — Read, or Grep with -C context against that path. A repo search, or reasoning from the titles mirror alone, is false.

shortlisted.description: titles carried out of the index scan, BEFORE verification — the audit trail that makes an empty result falsifiable

stoppedAt.description: where the procedure ended — distinguishes a legitimate early exit from a check that simply did not run; blocked when a needed read was missing or denied, with the cause in basis

basis.description: ONE sentence: what you examined and why it did or did not clear the overlap bar. This is the result-level justification; it never licenses prose inside overlaps[].

overlaps.description: Empty when nothing genuinely overlaps — that is the expected common case.
